summary: Specifies a way to describe typed relationships between web resources, called link relation types, and sets up a registry for them. It also defines the HTTP Link header field for carrying such links. It was a standards-track specification and was replaced by RFC 8288.

eli5.summary: Web pages can say "this is the next page" or "this is my author". This sets the labels for such connections and a header to send them. A newer document has since replaced it.

questions: what is the http link header
